channel.title: nexusEVnews
channel.description: Independent EV and renewable energy news, curated daily. Electric vehicles, solar, battery tech, and charging infrastructure.

item.title: Electric Cayenne Beats a Purosangue and an Urus, Then Out-Brakes Both
item.dc:creator: carwow
item.description: carwow lined up a Porsche Cayenne Turbo EV against a Ferrari Purosangue and a Lamborghini Urus Performante. The Porsche took the quarter mile in 10 seconds, then out-braked both by half a tonne.

item.title: The Cupra Raval Is Fun. The Motorway Range Is the Catch.
item.dc:creator: Autogefühl
item.description: Autogefühl ran the new Cupra Raval, mechanical twin of the VW ID. Polo, through motorway efficiency tests. About 280 km at 130 km/h, and a chassis good enough to make you forgive it.

item.title: The Ioniq 6 N's Real Nürburgring Trick Is Charging, Not Lap Time
item.dc:creator: Misha Charoudin
item.description: Misha Charoudin timed the charge, not the lap. The Ioniq 6 N came in at 22 percent after two laps of the Nordschleife and read 81 percent 21 minutes later.

item.title: Stand After Stand at Intersolar 2026 Sold the Same Stackable Battery
item.dc:creator: UpsideDownFork
item.description: UpsideDownFork walked the stands nobody makes a dedicated video about. Nearly all of them were selling the same thing: stackable plug-in solar storage you expand later.

item.title: The Rivian R2 Charges Far Better Than It Drives, and 92.8 Miles Proves It
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: Out of Spec charged an R2 for 15 minutes and drove it at 80 mph until empty. Excellent charging, 2.2 miles per kWh, and 92.8 miles on the board.

item.title: How Rivian Took Cost Out of the R2 Without Making It Feel Cheaper
item.dc:creator: Munro Live
item.description: Rivian's chief design officer walks Munro Live through the R2 and calls the whole car an exercise in removing cost where buyers will never notice.

item.title: McMurtry's Spéirling PURE Reaches Production Form, Wider and Easier to Own
item.dc:creator: McMurtry Automotive
item.description: The first pre-production Spéirling PURE is wider, mostly tyre, and built to run without a Formula 1 support crew. Max Chilton gets his first look.

item.title: IONNA Is Converting Circle K's Charging Sites to 400 kW in Four Days
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: IONNA CEO Seth Cutler tells Out of Spec Reviews the Circle K deal is landing months early, because the old sites were built with electrical headroom to spare.

item.title: Should You Wait for the LiDAR R2? One Owner Says the Chip Matters More
item.dc:creator: Tailosive EV
item.description: On Tailosive EV, the host argues R2 buyers weighing the LiDAR version should care more about Rivian's custom silicon than the sensor, and lines it up with the cheaper trim.

item.title: The Anker SOLIX E10 Pitch: Start Small, Add Batteries, Scale Later
item.dc:creator: Everyday Chris
item.description: In a sponsored video, Everyday Chris explains the Anker SOLIX E10, a modular home battery that scales from 6 to 90 kWh. The figures are the manufacturer's.

item.title: Seven Years On, the Kia e-Niro Still Does the Numbers That Matter
item.dc:creator: Electrifying
item.description: Electrifying makes the case for the 64 kWh first-generation e-Niro: over 250 real world miles, a strong battery health record, and a price that reflects how it looks.

item.title: The EU Wants 46 Percent of Its Energy to Be Electric by 2040
item.dc:creator: TLDR News EU
item.description: The Commission's electrification action plan doubles the target and leaves it non binding. TLDR News EU walks through the investment plan, then the arithmetic that makes it unlikely.

item.title: Tesla Brings v14 Lite to Hardware 3, and Out of Spec Put It Through Raleigh
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: A 2019 Model 3 with 170,000 miles gains reversing, parking and the v14 driving character. The channel says the confidence is transformed and the phantom braking is not.

item.title: What 2,000 Miles in a Model Y Actually Costs: $221 and 15 Charging Stops
item.dc:creator: Gjeebs
item.description: Gjeebs drove Arizona to Pennsylvania with two toddlers and logged every stop. 284 watt hours per mile, 6 hours 40 minutes plugged in, and one reason he left the Rivian at home.

item.title: Honda's £18,999 Super N Is Light, Efficient, and Short on Range
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric CARS
item.description: Everything Electric CARS reports 5 miles per kilowatt hour on the motorway and around 200 kg less than a Renault Twingo. Claimed range is 128 miles, and that is the whole debate.

item.title: The New Lexus ES Is Quick, Quiet, and Quick to Scold You
item.dc:creator: Throttle House
item.description: Throttle House takes the electric ES on a road trip. It is quiet, well calibrated and 340 hp, and it reported 47 driving incidents along the way.

item.title: The Self-Driving Story Nobody Is Telling
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The autonomy debate is all horse race. But for millions of people who cannot drive, a car that drives itself is the keys, handed back. Why Rivian's road to Level 4 matters more than the spec sheet, and the one thing it still has to get right.

item.title: We Built the Tracker We Wish Existed When We Were Waiting for Our R1s
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: People were reading website source code to find out when their Rivian was coming. Forum signatures listed Guide contact dates like military service records. We are not doing that again for the R2. The Rivian R2 Delivery Tracker is live.

item.title: Two Batteries, One Hitch, and the Case for All-Electric Glamping
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The Lightship AE1 carries its own 69 kWh battery and 80 kW motor to neutralize trailer drag on the tow vehicle. Paired with a Rivian, the real-world efficiency numbers are hard to argue with. This is what all-electric glamping looks like when the hardware actually works.

item.title: Atlanta, Rivian, and the Quiet Coincidence
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: Atlanta has a failing air quality grade and a Rivian plant on its doorstep. A hypothetical about what one city could do with the electric mobility infrastructure that already exists — R2 autonomous taxis, ALSO cargo quads, e-bikes, and ZTL-style restricted zones — and what the health data says the stakes actually are. Includes data from the HEI lockdown air quality study (Chen et al., 2025) and the American Lung Association's 2025 Atlanta air quality report.
